name: Devil Demonil Dewarill
original_name: デビル＝デモニラ＝デワーリル
source: An elite investigator from a different world correcting and investigating the distortion of space-time. Her aliases are Devil-child, Demoline, Debit, and various others depending on the mood of the protagonist. Her clothes and her wings are rather satanic. She seems kinda like an Imp, but contrarily to her appearance, she's a gentle fairy.
